dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just where are these things from exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Zhang Shun
dialogues.text: Of course not, I'm a sailor with The Crux. They're the spoils of years of service.

dialogues.speaker: Zhang Shun
dialogues.text: But I got injured during the battle against Haishan. If it weren't for Captain Beidou, I'd be a goner.

dialogues.speaker: Zhang Shun
dialogues.text: So I decided it best I leave The Crux. Can't have a crewmate's old injury flaring up and dragging the crew under...

dialogues.speaker: Zhang Shun
dialogues.text: At least the things I collected over the years is enough to keep me going though.
